description: Defines the lcid_dl_sch_t class representing Logical Channel ID for PDSCH in 5G NR, including enums, methods for validation, conversion, and size calculation, as well as a formatter specialization.

classes.name: ocudu::lcid_dl_sch_t
classes.description: Represents the Logical Channel ID for PDSCH with methods for validation, conversion, and size determination.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns an underlying_type value to lcid_dl_sch_t with validation.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the underlying integer value of the LCID.

methods.name: is_ce
methods.description: Checks if the LCID is a Control Element.

methods.name: is_sdu
methods.description: Checks if the LCID belongs to a Radio Bearer Logical Channel.

methods.name: to_lcid
methods.description: Converts LCID to lcid_t type after validation.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the LCID value is valid (not reserved).

methods.name: is_var_len_ce
methods.description: Indicates if the control element is variable length (always false here).

methods.name: sizeof_ce
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the control element based on LCID.
